note: Charged-current exclusive single-pion production cross sections as a function of neutrino energy, measured in the BNL 7-foot deuterium bubble chamber (wide-band beam, mean E_nu ~ 1.6 GeV). Three exclusive channels are given: nu_mu n -> mu- p pi0, nu_mu n -> mu- n pi+, and nu_mu p -> mu- p pi+ (all with hadronic mass W < 2 GeV), plus the pi+ p channel restricted to the Delta region W < 1.4 GeV. Values are absolute cross sections in 10^-38 cm^2. Only the raw published cross sections are ingested here; the NUISANCE _corr (Wilkinson/Rodriguez flux-corrected), event-count, W-shape and flux files are excluded.
